cost:
def cost(state, key) do
  cents = state
    |> Map.get("calls", [])
    |> Enum.filter(fn c -> c["key"] == key end)
    |> Enum.reduce(0, fn c, sum -> sum + c["tokens"] * price(state, c["model"]) / 1000 end)
  Float.round(cents / 100, 2)
end
keys_in_use:
defp keys_in_use(state) do
  state
  |> Map.get("calls", [])
  |> Enum.map(fn c -> c["key"] end)
  |> Enum.uniq()
  |> Enum.sort()
end
price: def price(state, model), do: state |> Map.get("prices", %{}) |> Map.get(model, 0)
quota_of: def quota_of(state, key), do: state |> Map.get("quotas", %{}) |> Map.get(key)
top_spender:
def top_spender(state) do
  case keys_in_use(state) do
    [] -> nil
    keys ->
      Enum.reduce(keys, nil, fn k, best ->
        if best == nil or cost(state, k) > cost(state, best), do: k, else: best
      end)
  end
end
usage:
def usage(state, key) do
  state
  |> Map.get("calls", [])
  |> Enum.filter(fn c -> c["key"] == key end)
  |> Enum.reduce(0, fn c, sum -> sum + c["tokens"] end)
end
